name: table-header-cell
description: A single column-header cell for a table's header row: a plain label, a sort button with a direction arrow when the column is sortable, and/or a favourite-all toggle for a Save column. Sibling cells sharing one [data-sort-group] container sort exclusively -- only one column at a time.

props.name: sortable
props.description: When true, renders the label inside a clickable sort button with a direction-arrow icon. When false, renders a plain, non-interactive label (unless favourite_all is also set).

props.name: sort_dir
props.description: Initial data-sort-dir: none, asc, or desc. Only meaningful when sortable=true.

props.name: favourite_all
props.description: For a Save column's header cell: adds a favourite-all toggle beside the sort button -- two independent click targets, the icon toggles every row's saved state and the arrow sorts by it. Sets data-favourite-all / data-type="icon-cell" on the cell so table-row's updateFavouriteAllState() and table-cell's favourite listener drive it (see rationale).

props.name: all_saved
props.description: Initial data-saved state for the favourite-all button. Only meaningful when favourite_all=true; table-row/component.js's updateFavouriteAllState() keeps it in sync at runtime once rows exist.

props.name: filter
props.description: Renders the label as a button that opens a dropdown-menu of values, for a column whose rows can be narrowed to one value. Sets data-filter / data-filter-value on the cell. Takes precedence over sortable. The page needs dropdown-menu's style.css and component.js as well.

props.name: filter_options
props.description: The values after the first item, each { value, label }. Only meaningful when filter=true. With filter_multiple, an option with selected=false starts unticked (every other one starts ticked).

props.name: filter_all_label
props.description: Label of the first item, whose value is "" and which clears the filter. Only meaningful when filter=true.

props.name: filter_icon
props.description: Only meaningful when filter=true. The icons/<name>.svg glyph beside the label: "arrow" (default) or "filter" -- Figma D_SYSTEM's filter glyph (node 38:2934), which its All table uses on a filterable column header.

props.name: filter_multiple
props.description: Only meaningful when filter=true. The menu is dropdown-menu's checkbox list (multiple=true), so several values show at once; the first item (filter_all_label) ticks or clears all. Sets data-filter-multiple and data-filter-values (the ticked values, space-separated) on the cell; ds-table-header-cell-filter carries { values }.

rationale:
Not built from a design-source instance: neither Penpot nor Figma had a column header with a sort affordance when it was built. It generalizes a working pattern from this repo's earlier sample table (site.css / site.js); every visual value was already token-bound there. Styled since to Figma's header cell (Table cell, header-cell text+icon: default 35:8275, hovered 35:8396, selected 35:8423) and the flat table: 44px plus a 1px hairline like a row. Labels use the "data" role (Inter Medium 13px, uppercase) in both themes -- type doesn't depend on the theme -- in the header-cell-label token (base/600) in light and text-subactive in dark.

Sortable: default is the header gray on the plain cell; hovered is black on base/100; selected -- the column with data-sort-dir asc or desc -- is the accent color on base/100, label and arrow always sharing one color. The label keeps its dotted underline (sorting stays in the view) and the 24px arrow (icons/arrow-down.svg) stays visible in every state, 10px from the label. The sort and favourite-all buttons carry the 10px cell padding, so the whole cell is clickable. Siblings in one [data-sort-group] sort exclusively. The component doesn't reorder rows: it cycles data-sort-dir and dispatches a bubbling event, and the host sorts its own rows -- a reusable header can't know the host table's row shape.

favourite_all: a Save column's header needs two independent click targets in one cell -- the icon toggles every row's saved state, a separate arrow sorts by it. The cell carries data-favourite-all and data-type="icon-cell" so table-row's updateFavouriteAllState() and table-cell's favourite listener drive it; the icon markup is hand-matched to table-cell's icon-cell (a nested .ds-table-cell would draw a doubled box), so it isn't declared in `uses`, and the icon-cell padding it picks up is reset for the header layout.

Filter (no design-source node): a header cell whose label opens a dropdown-menu of values. It reuses the sortable header's three states (selected = a value is chosen or the menu is open) and the 24px arrow, or Figma D_SYSTEM's filter glyph (node 38:2934) with filter_icon="filter". The label keeps the column's name. The component records the choice (data-filter-value, accent state, aria-selected) and dispatches ds-table-header-cell-filter with {value, label}; the host narrows its rows. The dropdown wrapper and menu markup are hand-matched, so dropdown-menu isn't in `uses` and a host links its CSS and JS itself. Rendering verified in light and dark themes. Filter, multiple (explicit request 2026-10-01: a Status column that shows several statuses at once, all but Archived and Filtered by default): the same header button, with dropdown-menu's checkbox list (included, so the item markup has one source). Its "All" item is ticked when every value is and half-ticked when only some are; the button is accent while any value is left out, the same "this column is filtered" state as the single filter. Column resize (explicit request 2026-10-01, no design source): opt-in with data-column-resize on the grid container (its value a name; the widths are not remembered across a reload, explicit request 2026-10-12, and a value stored by an earlier version under "ds-columns:<name>" is cleared). Each header cell but the last column gets pane's split handle on its right edge (8px grab area inside the cell, 2px accent line on hover, focus and drag). Dragging moves a column's right border and the columns after it share the difference in proportion (none under the minimum), so the table keeps its width and the columns to the left stay put; arrow keys move it 24px, a double click restores the CSS widths. Sizes are applied as data-columns-resized + --_column-sizes (minmax(0, <px>fr) per column, so a resized table keeps its proportions at another window width), never under spacing.9, and a column marked data-resize-min="content" (on its header cell or a wrapper around it) never under what its content needs: measured at the start of each drag by laying the grid out once with those columns at max-content, and kept as the track's CSS floor (minmax(max-content, ...)) so content that grows later still fits (explicit request 2026-10-01: buttons, a checkbox or a status never squeezed until they no longer fit); cells in a resized table drop their min-width so a column can be narrower than its content. Each drag, arrow step or reset fires ds-table-columns-resize { before, after } (px, or null for the CSS widths) and the container takes ds-table-columns-set { sizes } back, so a host can undo a resize (the consuming app's Ctrl+Z).
a11y_notes: The sort button is a native <button> with an aria-label ("Sort by <label>") stating the action; the direction is in data-sort-dir and not announced separately -- a host using a real <table> could add aria-sort on the header cell (the component assumes a CSS grid of divs, like table-row). Filter: the trigger is a native <button> with aria-haspopup="listbox", aria-expanded kept by dropdown-menu, and an aria-label naming the column and, once chosen, the value ("Filter by Type: Analysed"); the menu is a role="listbox" of role="option" buttons with aria-selected on the chosen one. Escape and an outside click close it. Filter, multiple: the menu is aria-multiselectable; aria-label lists the shown values while some are left out ("Filter by Status: For review, Analysed"). Column resize: each handle is a focusable role="separator" (aria-orientation vertical, aria-label "Resize <label>"); ArrowLeft / ArrowRight move the border 24px.
